thread:
alana: follow-up from the observability RFC: we still haven't landed on a reconciliation window or a minimal provenance schema. this ambiguity is leaking into qstores and customer telemetry.
viktor: agreed. two knobs: reconciliation cadence (how often we run the join) and visibility (what we surface as "live" vs "final"). both affect UX and cost.
mike: data point from sampling: ~3.2% of envelopes get their billing resolved after enrich; those represent about 6.9% of token spend. small population, high impact.
sophia: UX suggestion: show two numbers in billing dashboards: "estimate_now" (derived from ingest_hint/enricher values) and "settled" (post-reconciler). mark settled with timestamp settled_at. allow API param ?settled=true to opt in.
\valana: spelling nit :)
vlktor: heh. implementation idea: add a small flat set of fields to envelope: billing_key, provenance (enum: ingest_hint|enricher|settled), settled_at, last_change_by, last_change_reason, last_change_ts. keep it flat to avoid storage complexity.
mike: agree on flat fields. we should version the schema: provenance_schema_version = "1" so UIs can evolve.
sophia: reconciliation cadence options: hourly, 6h, daily. ops prefers daily to start to limit heavy joins. daily at 03:00 UTC behind feature flag seems pragmatic.
alana: reconciliation behavior: reconciler should only set settled if either joined match has confidence >= JOIN_THRESHOLD or the joined external id matches a canonical store. otherwise, don't override.
mike: propose constants: ENRICH_ACCEPT_THRESHOLD = 0.9 (enricher can overwrite at ingest if confidence >= threshold), RECONCILE_JOIN_CONFIDENCE = 0.7 (reconciler can accept lower confidence if external evidence present). open to tweaks.
sophia: we need an audit trail that is cheap. Instead of arrays, keep last_change_by + last_change_reason + last_change_ts. finance wants the who/why/timestamp; full history not required for v1.
viktor: operational metrics: reconciliations_applied counter, billing_delta_ratio histogram, envelopes_missing_hint gauge. alert on reconciliations_applied spike >1%/hr.
mike: SDK ergonomics: add obs.resolve_billing(span_id, prefer_settled=false) helper. UI uses prefer_settled=false by default; power users can request settled. That avoids client-side expensive joins for common flows.
sophia: migration/backfill: backfill last 7 days using current enriched outputs as provenance="enricher". run a 5% canary for 48h; monitor reconciliations_applied and billing_delta_ratio.
ops-bot: deploy-plan: reconciler-canary scheduled Monday 03:00 UTC behind flag obs.billing_reconcile_v1 :gear:
viktor: edge case: multi-tenant traces where different spans map to different tenants. proposal: envelope-level canonical tenant + optional span_owner_ref flag per-span. span_owner_ref is a tiny bitset pointing to envelope owner to avoid copying strings.
alana: that bitset approach reduces cardinality explosion. expose helper index span_id -> envelope_owner for debug queries; index only when span_owner_ref=1 to limit cost.
mike: storage estimate: adding provenance+settled_at+audit ~+22 bytes/envelope -> ~0.6% storage. finance ok. indexing ~10% of spans as owner refs estimated +1.2% storage. still a big win versus copying full tenant per-span.
sophia: action items: 1) viktor: schema PR with flat fields + provenance version 2) mike: SDK helper + API param 3) alana: backfill spec + canary plan 4) ops: schedule canary and ramp playbook. I'll draft RFC addendum summarizing thresholds and rollout.
viktor: I'll include pseudocode for reconciler in the PR.
mike: quick pseudocode idea:
```
# reconciler pseudocode
if envelope.provenance == "settled": skip
if joined_key != null and (joined_confidence >= RECONCILE_JOIN_CONFIDENCE or external_match):
  if joined_key != envelope.billing_key:
    set envelope.billing_key = joined_key
    set provenance = "settled"
    set last_change_by = "reconciler:daily"
    set last_change_reason = "join match"
    set last_change_ts = now
```
sophia: perfect. one more: add metric reconciler_latency and reconciler_error_rate to watch perf during ramp.
ops-bot: reminder: arch sync Fri 09:30 UTC  add billing reconcile rollout to agenda.
alana: thanks folks. unless anyone objects I'll push the RFC addendum and land the schema PR tomorrow.
viktor: +1
mike: +1 :thumbsup:
sophia: +1
